title: Granny Flat Construction quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Construction of a 60m² detached granny flat on a residential property in Merrylands, NSW. Includes: 60m² concrete slab and footings (100mm slab, 400x400mm footings); MGP10 timber frame for a one-bedroom, one-bathroom layout; Colorbond skillion roof in 'Surfmist'; Scyon Linea external cladding, painted; Internal plasterboard walls and ceilings; R2.5 wall insulation and R4.0 ceiling insulation; L-shaped laminate kitchen with basic appliances (oven, cooktop, rangehood, sink); Full bathroom fit-out (shower, toilet, 900mm vanity); Standard plumbing and electrical connections including a 250L electric hot water system; Four aluminium windows (1200x900mm), one 2400x2100mm sliding glass door, one external entry door, and one internal door; Internal painting and vinyl plank flooring for living areas, carpet for bedroom.
workingDetail: Concrete slab and footings, Timber or steel frame, Roofing (Colorbond), External cladding
